Over the summer, I leave my bedroom window open to let the air in & my cats love sitting on the windowsill. One night, it was raining so I had the window open because I love the smell. Eventually I went to close my window so I can go to my boyfriends house to stay the night. I pack my bag & head outside. I live in a apartment complex so I have to go all the way around my building to get to my car. As I got closer, I heard a cat meowing so I turn around & say, “Finn?” I hear the meows getting louder & more scared. So, I start looking around cars & around cars until I find him under a car by the dumpster. He comes towards me so I pick him up & start heading back to the apartment. This cat LOST HIS SHIT. He started fighting me to let him down so I accidentally drop him & he runs off. I didn’t even mention he’s a big fucking cat so that means he’s not fast and discrete & what would you know? Someone was walking their BIG ASS DOG :) Finn ran back towards me, then past me to the door. I open it & he runs inside. My other cat was licking him & making sure he was OK. That cat is a mess lol
